title: Apple Wants $999 for a NEW iPhone Duo Screen 😳
description:
Apple now sells iPhone Duo repair parts — and the folding inner screen costs $999, half the price of the phone.

Apple just added the iPhone Duo to its Self Service Repair Store. The inner display assembly is $999 ($839.16 after returning your old part), the inner panel alone is $499, the outer screen $379, and the tool kit rents for $49 for 7 days. The twist: Apple's own out-of-warranty inner-screen repair is also $999.
